narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Keep all four fives, so I take all four fives first.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The last five is the very last digit of the number.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Ten digits cannot all be kept if we jump to it, and the slip is struck out.
removed_beats.on_screen: the slip's bubble appears with all four fives first; the last digit is marked; the slip is struck through

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Put the biggest possible digit in front.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Then do the same for the next place.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Count the strikes so ten digits stay.
removed_beats.on_screen: the words biggest in front appear; the words next place appear; the words count the strikes appear

old_misconception.wrong_move: A common slip grabs all four fives at the front. Only ten digits stay, so the fives cannot all be reached.
